# Mixpanel — Mixpanel for Startups

One year free on the Mixpanel Startup plan including the full product suite, with 1 billion events and 1 million Session Replays; Mixpanel states the package is worth $145,000.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open - apply directly |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-14 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [📊 Analytics & Data](../categories/analytics.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | free plan |
| **Maximum** | $145,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **When it ends** | Page states: "When the year is up, we'll help you find the right plan. No vendor lock-in, no surprise billing." |


### Not covered

- companies that have previously been on a Mixpanel paid plan
- companies that have previously redeemed other Mixpanel offers

### Notes

The FAQ accordion on https://mixpanel.com/startups/ renders only question headers to a fetcher; the answers (including "What are the eligibility requirements?") did not load, and https://mixpanel.com/startups-apply/ returned a title-only shell. Eligibility below is taken from Mixpanel's own blog at https://mixpanel.com/blog/mixpanel-for-startups-whats-new/, which states startups must be "Incorporated less than five years ago", have "Raised no more than $8M (USD) in total funding", and "Haven't been on a paid plan". VENDOR SELF-CONTRADICTION: the /startups page advertises "1 billion events, 1 million Session Replays" and a $145,000 value, while the blog describes a 500k Session Replay recordings allowance and a value "over $150,000"; the conservative figure quoted here is the current /startups page one. Treat the funding and age caps as needing confirmation on the live FAQ. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
